newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine foreign reserves hit record on bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Argentine foreign reserves hit record on bill sale.

text.p: Argentine foreign reserves hit a record Monday because the payments on last week's treasury bill auction were made that day, traders said Thursday.

The Central Bank announced earlier foreign reserves on Monday rose to an all time high of $21.72 billion. That was because the bank received the $250 million in payments for the 91-day treasury bills it auctioned last week.
Argentina's Convertibility plan pegging the peso to the dollar at par obliges the government to match every peso in circulation with dollars, gold or government bonds in reserve.
